learning_outcomes.text: Apply gained theoretical knowledge to design an engineering task from the branch of energetics, from chemical, food, or process industries.

syllabus_topics: Design of brand new operating sets or processing lines for chemical, food, or process industries
Design of advanced equipment and operating sets for both classical and decentralized energy systems with an emphasis on improving their parameters and using renewable or alternative sources

Optimization of existing systems in terms of intensification of transport phenomena, increase in productivity, heat recovery, reduction in energy demand, minimization of waste generation and ecological impacts
Design and optimization of equipment for new systems with an emphasis on the use of modern R & D trends
Experimental and CFD analysis of processes in equipment to optimize transport phenomena in terms of energy requirement and processing time, including the definition of suitable scale-up parameters
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
